sections.title: Language switch styles
sections.what: Styles the language switch button with a border, background, colour and focus outline, and makes it larger on phones.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The same button is styled in globals.css, so check both files when it looks wrong.

summary: Styles the language switch button, including a larger tap target on phones.
purpose: Gives the language switch a consistent look and focus outline.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It sits alongside similar header rules in globals.css.
how: Sets the button's size, padding, border, colour and weight. Adds a focus outline for keyboard users. Below 760 pixels, makes the button wider and taller.
inputs: No runtime inputs. Uses colour variables defined elsewhere.
outputs: A styled language switch button wherever the locale-switch class is used.
risks: globals.css also styles the same button, so whichever rule comes later wins. The file is one line, so it is easy to break by hand.
debug: Inspect the language button in browser developer tools to see which rules apply. Check that the class name matches the markup.
